about.title: About All American Electric
text: General contractors, property managers and owners across Greater Houston count on our crews for tenant build-outs, retail and restaurant work, and commercial service calls — on bid, on schedule, on budget.

When the Texas grid goes down, your lights stay on. As an authorized Generac dealer we size, install, service and maintain standby generators for homes and businesses — and we install and service Cummins, Kohler and Briggs & Stratton units too — including the pad, gas line, transfer switch, permits and startup.
You approve a written price before we start. No hourly surprises, no hidden fees, no "while we're here" upsells.
